Canada accelerates sovereign defense with new Arctic and space tenders. 🛰️

### Aerospace & Defence
The Department of National Defence has issued notices for Commercial Satellite Imagery and Space Situational Awareness Observations alongside the Polar Helicopter Project. Technical mandates demand commercial orbital data feeds and spare parts delivery to the Canadian Forces Supply Depot in Montreal by March 1, 2027. Defence contractors and manufacturers should structure joint tender submissions and secure bonded transport corridors to fulfill federal delivery terms.

### Cross-Border Logistics
The Canada Border Services Agency is adjusting schedules at nine British Columbia ports of entry on November 1, 2026, amid heightened screening following commercial firearm interdictions. Fleet operators face elevated manual examination risks and border dwell penalties at crossings including Aldergrove, Carson, and Cascade. Logistics managers should redesign cross-border transit schedules and validate pre-arrival EDI filings to prevent terminal clearance delays.

### Regulatory & Trade Compliance
An Order in Council enacts centralized Contraventions Act ticketing on November 1, 2026, complementing the Bedford Sherrard Remission Order under the Financial Administration Act. The statutory overhaul unifies summary enforcement across the Health of Animals Act and Plant Protection Act. Corporate counsel and agricultural operators must update compliance standard operating procedures to align with consolidated federal penalty schedules.
